note: The images the owner pushes to the project registry before the catalog task or the persistent catalog service is enabled. Push each by digest into the repository named here, then record the digest in the variable file, which stays out of Git. The selected releases below were decided by the owner on Nov 3 2026 (OpenMetadata and host sizing). A digest of TO_RESOLVE has not been read yet: the owner resolves it with `docker buildx imagetools inspect <upstream>:<release>` and pushes the linux/arm64 image. The persistent service takes server, ingestion and search; the finite catalog task also takes database.
platform: linux/arm64 for the persistent service (verified Nov 3 2026). The finite catalog task keeps linux/amd64 until its own database image passes the same check.
arm64_check: docker buildx imagetools inspect <upstream>:<release> lists linux/arm64 for each of the four images
